# SkillSwap

> SkillSwap is a peer-to-peer skill barter and reciprocal knowledge exchange platform. Creators, engineers, designers, and specialists trade expertise 1-on-1 without exchanging fiat currency.

## Core Architecture & Barter Economics
- **Zero-Fiat Knowledge Barter**: Direct trade where users match based on what they want to learn and what they can teach (e.g., teaching Next.js in exchange for 3D Blender modeling or conversational Italian).
- **TimeBank Escrow System**: Platform credits earned by verified teaching hours and redeemed for learning sessions from other community members.
- **Mutual Compatibility Matcher**: Two-way weighted scoring algorithm that indexes teaching proficiencies against seeking wishlists to deliver instant reciprocity matches (up to 98% compatibility).
- **5-Stage Barter Deal Pipeline**: Proposed -> Accepted -> Scheduled -> In Session -> Completed.
- **Verified Proof Matrix**: Portfolio verification, verifiable credentials, and peer karma endorsements.

## Primary Public Endpoints
- Homepage & Barter Matchmaker: https://skillswap.io/
- Discover Skills & Mentors: https://skillswap.io/discover
- Instant Compatibility Matches: https://skillswap.io/matches
- Verified Professionals Directory: https://skillswap.io/professionals
- Learning Pathways: https://skillswap.io/learn
- Teaching Hub: https://skillswap.io/teach
- Community Exchange Forum: https://skillswap.io/community
- Platform Mission & Manifesto: https://skillswap.io/about
- Help Center & FAQ: https://skillswap.io/help

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Wouter client routing, Lucide icons, AnimeJS micro-interactions.
- State: SkillSwap Reciprocity Context with local persistence and Supabase backend integration.
- API & Security: Express API, strict CORS, CSP headers, rate-limiting, and sanitized inputs.

## Canonical Identity
- Website: https://skillswap.io
- Status: Production Ready
